notes: Built (lane gap-perf, docs/lanes/gap-perf.md): perf/thirty-one.py now reads only measures the app serves. The script prints `PASS <cell>` per passing cell, `FAIL` / `NOT JUDGED` on stderr, a reading of 0 is not judged (selftest rows mem-zero, gap-zero).
